text:
incident-bot: Paging on-call for control-plane 5xx spike (severity: high). Alert id: CP-5XX-2026-03-15-01. >5% 5xx error rate over 5m for control-plane endpoints (/v1/model, /v1/embeddings). Initial signal from gateway metrics. Pager: @sara_oncall

sara_oncall: acked, looking. can someone drop current rate graphs and recent deploys? :eyes:

mike_sre: i can pull metrics. looks like spike started ~2026-03-15T20:58Z, ramping to ~8% at 21:01Z.

mike_sre: wavefront link: https://wavefront/redwood/dashboard/control-plane-5xx (shortlink)

sara_oncall: thanks. checking control-plane logs now. quick check: are we running the new org-lookup caching change from yesterday?

levi_prodeng: yes, that config rolled out 2026-03-15T03:10Z (commit abc123). It toggles realtime org lookup and tighter timeouts for auth calls.

sara_oncall: that's suspicious. seeing a lot of downstream timeouts to auth-service and org-lookup. sample gateway log: 
```
[2026-03-15T21:00:12Z] proxy: incoming /v1/model -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream: auth 504 org-lookup 503)
[2026-03-15T21:00:13Z] proxy: request id=xyz123 latency=245ms upstream_status=504 auth_req_id=auth-7c9
[2026-03-15T21:00:14Z] proxy: cache-miss org=acct-42; downstream-error=502
```

irene_support: customers reporting elevated 502s on hosted api. first customer tickets trickling in. noting this to post on status page if impact persists.

sara_oncall: root cause hypothesis: aggressive auth/org-lookup timeout changes causing cascade when auth has transient slowness.

mike_sre: running quick grep on auth logs: high number of connection resets from control-plane around 20:58-21:02. auth pod restarts? checking k8s events.

mike_sre: `kubectl -n auth get pods` shows 2/3 pods restarted in the last 5m. pulling pod logs now.

levi_prodeng: can we enable fallback: cache org lookup for 30s and bypass realtime path? runbook suggests fallback toggle `org_lookup.realtime=false`.

sara_oncall: doing that now. patching config in control-plane canary and will monitor.

sara_oncall: applied `org_lookup.realtime=false` on canary (10% traffic). watching error rate.

mike_sre: canary looks better: canary 5xx down to 1.2% after 30s. global still high.

sara_oncall: rolling the config rollback to 50%, then 100%. doing 50% -> 100%.

jen-docs: noted for the runbook: this is the sensible fallback while auth team investigates. adding blurb now.

sara_oncall: rolled to 100%. global 5xx dropped to 0.9% within 60s. good signal.

irene_support: customer impact: roughly 12% of requests to hosted API experienced errors during the ~4m spike window. top affected customers: AcmeCorp (higher rate), BetaApps (minor). open tickets: #4521, #4522.

sara_oncall: quick mitigation summary: rolled back realtime org lookup change and increased auth timeouts to pre-change values. notified auth owners.

mike_sre: auth team reports a transient dependency (billing lookup) was slow, causing auth token validation to queue up and restart some auth pods. investigating billing dependency fanout.

toni_platform: I'm on billing-deps. saw brief spike in external billing API latency at 20:56Z-21:00Z; retries caused resource pressure. throttle added now.

levi_prodeng: sounds like a chain: external billing slow -> auth dependent calls backlog -> auth pod restarts -> control-plane realtime org lookup tight timeouts -> 5xx from gateway.

sara_oncall: key actions taken: 1) rolled org_lookup.realtime=false 2) restored auth timeouts 3) scaled auth replicas by +2 4) throttled billing external retries

mike_sre: verifying metrics: cpu on auth down to normal, pod restarts stopped. 5xx at gateway stable <1%.

irene_support: will draft status page message with mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem.

sara_oncall: i'm going to hand off to levi for deeper RCA and postmortem. leaving notes: start=2026-03-15T20:58Z, mitigated ~21:03Z. impact: transient 5xx spike, customer-facing errors for ~4m window, mitigated by feature rollback and auth scaling.

levi_prodeng: taking over. summary added to incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/incidents/CP-5XX-2026-03-15 (shortlink). will coordinate with auth and billing teams.

toni_platform: will join RCA. suspected root cause: external billing latency + aggressive timeout/config changes.

jen-docs: assigning postmortem owner: @levi_prodeng. draft targeted for EOD tomorrow. I'll help with timeline and customer message.

sara_oncall: thanks team. marking incident as mitigated. on-call clear from my side. paging cleared. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident CP-5XX-2026-03-15 marked mitigated by sara_oncall. Runbook used: control-plane-fallback-org-lookup. Postmortem assigned to levi_prodeng.

levi_prodeng: next steps: collect logs from auth/billing, timeline of deploys, config changes (commit abc123), and customer ticket export. I'll schedule a 30m RCA sync in #eng-sre in 30m.

irene_support: prepping customer comms draft, will post after Levi's notes.

mike_sre: adding alert tuning note: add hold buffer so transient external spikes don't flip control-plane timeouts so quickly.

jen-docs: documenting mitigation steps in runbook and adding follow-up tasks.

sara_oncall: handing off — thanks everyone.

levi_prodeng: acknowledged, will follow up and close loop.
